suitability.reason: No likeness reference was supplied. Primary anthropometric measurements support a proportionally credible, code-only real-time hand, while surface anatomy remains intentionally stylized.

definitionOfDone: Palm volume plus five separately named digits
Middle finger longest; index and ring close; little finger shortest
Thumb opposed at an explicit trigonometric angle
Left and right attachments mathematically mirrored
Wrist overlap and ball-contact socket exposed for animation
blockingFailures: Hand length or breadth differs more than one percent from the normalized formulas

evidence.caveat: U.S. military personnel data are not globally representative.

evidence.population: 100 adults, 50 men and 50 women, ages 18-65, university/community sample
evidence.caveat: A regional convenience sample intended to resemble industrial employees; it does not encode all ages, disabilities, or global populations.

remainingLimitations: No nail plates, palm creases, or explicit knuckle folds
Digits use two visual segments rather than three independently rigged phalanges
Anthropometric ratios are population anchors, not a claim of a universal hand
